# PersonaPulse AI

> Forensic AI for behavioral psychology — decode hidden intentions, personality traits, and manipulation tactics in conversations, then architect strategic responses.

PersonaPulse AI analyzes chat excerpts and messages to surface subtext, detect manipulation, score psychological patterns, and generate response strategies tailored to a target recipient.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Paste a conversation to run a forensic analysis and get strategic response options.
- [History & Privacy](/history): Your saved analyses and how we handle your data.

## Optional

- [Privacy](/privacy): Data handling summary (redirects to History & Privacy).
